_doc: QA configuration for qa.py. Categories define box limits; 'banks' assigns a category to a bank ('<narc>/<NNNN>'); unassigned banks are auto-classified (dialogue if any zh string has {SCROLL}/{CLEAR}, else 'ui'). A workspace bank file may override with a top-level "category", and a string with "category". Pixel limits come from pret/pokeheartgold (dialog_box.c: 27x4 tiles) and the ROM font (font_widths.json). See work/notes/text_metrics.md.

dialogue.desc: field/script message box, 27x4 tiles = 216x32 px, font 1

battle.desc: battle message box (ov12 AddWindow bg1 2,19,27x4), font 1. prompt_px: a string that waits with a prompt ({VAR:0200:..}) shows two icons at x 211-228 of the window (text origin x 16), so the lines of that view must end by 195 px (emulator sweep 2026-10-06, emu_sweeps battle)

sign.desc: signpost box with the map/wayfinding graphic on the left (dialog_box.c type 0/1: x+7 tiles, 20x4 tiles = 160 px). Assign per string/bank when known.

locations.desc: map names; vanilla US max 17 chars

ui.desc: menus/labels with unknown box: warn when an English line is wider than the widest Chinese line of the bank, or has more lines than the Chinese

pokedex.desc: Pokédex entry text box (bank 0791); US HG entries are 3 lines, max 204 px; other US entry banks reach 222 px. No {SCROLL}.

dex_category.desc: Pokédex entry page, species category incl. ' Pokémon' (bank 0803; D-1520): drawn at x=120 with 1 px between characters, the last visible column is x=246 (127 px). Measured on all 709 entries: rendered width = font px + characters + 2, so font px + characters <= 125.

move_desc.desc: move description panel (summary screen / move relearner / TM bag): measured on the official US bank 0749 = 467 entries, max 5 lines, max 120 px per line (font 0 and 1 identical), no {SCROLL}. Hack zh 0738 also uses up to 5 lines.

item_desc.desc: item description panel (Bag / Poké Mart): measured on the official US bank 0221 = 514 entries, max 3 lines, max 215 px per line (52 lines at 215, none wider; font 0 and 1 identical), {NEWLINE} only. Hack zh 0218 uses 3 lines (4-5 only on hack TM items). Bag panel (emulator, D-1512): window 27x6 tiles at x=40 (overlay 3 template 02 05 12 1B 06, same in US), the grey panel ends at x=239, so lines over 200 px run into the frame (warning line_past_frame; vanilla US does the same with its 201-215 px lines); 215 px stays the error limit (window edge). Buffer (D-1507): the bag, shop and overlay-9 consumers allocate String_New(114): more than 114 stored units incl. terminator shows a blank panel (error too_many_units).
item_desc.soft_desc: runs into the bag panel's right frame

ability_desc.desc: ability description (summary screen): measured on the official US bank 0722 = 124 entries, max 2 lines, max 136 px per line (font 0 and 1 identical), {NEWLINE} only. The hack's own custom descriptions in 0712 (#311-326) are also 2 lines of <= 10 hanzi.

berry_desc.desc: berry tag description (bank 0243): the US counterpart (0250) is blanked (spaces only), so the box is taken from the hack's zh: 64 entries, max 3 lines, max 180 px (15 hanzi) per line. {NEWLINE} only. Probably a DP leftover screen; verify in game.

gear_map.desc: Pokégear map card, place description (0266 #9-117; D-1524): window 26x4 tiles at x=24 (hack overlay 92 template 05 03 0E 1A 04; the JP layout the hack is built on; US widened it to 28 tiles at x=8). Two lines, 208 px.

gear_map_town.desc: Pokégear map card, towns and cities (0266 #10-29, #31): the town picture starts at x=193, so text from x=24 must stay within 168 px (one column of gap). Seen in the emulator on 14 towns; the rest of #10-31 are towns assumed to have the picture too.

menu_touch_1line.desc: touch menu with 2-4 options: one full-width button per option, window 28x2 tiles = 224 px, ONE line. Measured by follow-up 1 (menu-width audit): script menus are cmd 749/750 MenuInit(StdGmm) + 751 MenuItemAdd + 752 MenuExec (bottom-screen touch buttons, pret ov27_0225C618 = hack overlay 28: window templates ov27_0225D4B8, text in font 4 at x=0) or cmd 64/65 + 66 + 67 (top-screen window, pret ov01_021EDC84: width = ceil((widest option in font 0 + 12)/8) tiles at tile x, frame 1 tile each side, must end by tile 31). Assigned per string ("category" field) to every option a script menu uses; a string used by several menus gets the tightest one. NOTE: the build keeps the hack's font 4, whose space is 7 px; QA's default vanilla_us set measures it at 5 px, so leave 2 px per space of margin.

trainer_names.desc: trainer names (a027/0719, US 0729). The battle copies a name into u16[8] (EnemyTrainerSet_Init, hack arm9 0x02072544) and drops it if it doesn't fit, so the build stores these names {COMPRESSED} (9-bit packing: 10 characters in 7 units), like US. Every code must be < 0x1FF. See 'compressed_banks' and D-1326.

frontier_names.desc: Battle Frontier trainer names (a027/0026, US 0027): copied uncompressed into u16[8] (hack arm9 0x0204AD38 after the load at 0x0204ACFC), so 7 characters max, like US.

string_categories._doc: Per-string categories for banks that mix screens: {"<narc>/<NNNN>": {"<ids>": category}} (ids like 10-29,31; later keys win). A string's own "category" field still wins.

var_widths._doc: Estimated expansion width (px) of {VAR:01KK:..} placeholders, keyed by command id. typ = used for the error threshold, max = worst case (warning). Latin glyphs are 6 px. Kinds from pret gmm usage: 00 species, 01 nickname, 03 player/trainer name, 04 location, 05 ability, 06 move, 08 item, 0D stat, 0E trainer class, 0F type, 1C easy-chat word, 32-3B numbers (digits = kind-49). battle_string kinds (emulator, 2026-10-06): 0100 trainer name, 0102/010C Pokémon (nickname, 10 chars), 0103 type, 0106 ability, 0107 move, 0109 item, 010E trainer class, 010F number (printed with the full-width digit codes 0x00A2-0x00AB, 7-8 px wide in font 1).

compressed_banks._doc: Banks the build stores {COMPRESSED} (ws.export applies it; build.py verifies it). raw_ids stay uncompressed, exactly like US 0729 ids 707-711: the Frontier Brain VS screen (hack ov77 0x0223616A, US ov80 0x0223A212) prints those names with no message formatter, so they must be plain text and fit u16[8] (raw_max_chars). max_units = the fixed buffer the battle copies into (u16[8] incl. the 0xFFFF terminator).

passthrough_banks._doc: Official foreign-language Pokédex data the hack ships untranslated (dex entries 0793-0797, species names 0804-0808, categories 0809-0813, in EN/FR/DE/IT/ES). Not published: .gitignore excludes the bank files and `ws.py init` regenerates them from work/extract/v4, every string kept as is (en = zh, origin copy, note 'foreign-language data, kept as is (<language>)').

glossary_names._doc: qa.py glossary_name lint: capitalised English name spans in prose are compared with the known names (glossary, name banks 0232/0739/0219/0711 and their 'abbreviated from' notes, 0724/0033/0183, active register terms). Hits: old_names (Gen 4 spellings, error for species/moves), a spelling variant of a known name (same letters, different spacing/case/accents), a name-bank abbreviation used in prose (warning), or an unknown word one edit away from a species/move/item/ability (fuzzy). 'allow' lists reviewed false positives with the reason; per string use qa_ignore 'glossary_name' or 'glossary_name:<span>'.
